replies.reasoning: The selection is Front left steering: a hinge joint around the vertical axis limited to -35..35 degrees, driven by a position motor with max force 2000 N.

content.answer: This is the front left steering. Its hinge joint turns the wheel around the vertical axis, between -35 and 35 degrees, and a position motor with up to 2000 N of force holds the angle the brain asks for. Together with the right steering it decides where the car points.
